data.name: Privacy_P1
data.value: Jumbo (the website jumbo.uz and the Jumbo mobile app) is a platform for learning English, including for children. This document explains what data we collect and how we use it.

data.name: Privacy_P2
data.value: • Account: first name, last name, username, password (stored only as a hash), and optionally a phone number and an avatar. • Region, school and team (class), chosen from lists. • Learning: learned words, finished topics and games, LP points, awards, purchases in the game market made with in-game points, daily goal and streak, exam results. • Settings: language, theme, study languages. • Optionally, the connection of the Telegram reminder bot (we receive the chat id and the first name in Telegram). • Technical server data (address, time of a request) in ordinary logs, for security and for running the service.

data.name: Privacy_P3
data.value: • So that you can sign in and continue from where you stopped. • To show your place in the weekly rating of the team, school or region. • So that the teacher and the director of your school can see the progress of the team and the exam results. • To send reminders if you connected Telegram. We do not use the data for advertising and we do not sell it.

data.name: Privacy_P4
data.value: Jumbo is suitable for any age, including children. We ask only for what is needed for learning: a phone number is optional. We show no ads, we use no advertising or analytics services, and we do not pass children's data to third parties for marketing. It is best for a child to register together with a parent or a teacher. A parent can ask at any time to see or delete the child's data: it is enough to delete the account (see below) or to write to us.

data.name: Privacy_P5
data.value: • Other learners see your name and place in the rating. To hide your name, turn on "Hide my name in the rating" in Settings. • The teacher and the director of the team you joined see your progress and exam results. • The data is kept on our servers. We do not give it to third parties unless the law requires it. If you connected Telegram, messages pass through Telegram.

data.name: Privacy_P6
data.value: Data travels over a secure connection (HTTPS). Passwords are stored as a hash. The data is kept as long as the account exists.

data.name: Privacy_P7
data.value: You can delete the account yourself: "Settings" → "Delete account" (in the app and on the website). The profile, progress, words, awards, purchases and exam results are deleted for good. More: jumbo.uz/delete-account. Backup copies of the database may keep the data for a limited time and are deleted afterwards.

data.name: Privacy_P8
data.value: Questions about data can be sent to the contact below. If we change this document, the new version appears on this page with a new date.

data.name: Del_Intro
data.value: You can delete your account and all the data of it yourself, at any time. It takes a minute.

data.name: Del_Steps
data.value: 1. Sign in to your account (in the Jumbo app or on jumbo.uz). 2. Open "Settings" and scroll to the bottom to "Delete account". 3. Enter your password and confirm.

data.name: Del_What
data.value: The profile (name, username, password, phone, avatar), the progress, learned words, awards, purchases and exam results, the Telegram link. It cannot be undone. Backup copies of the database may keep the data for a limited time and are deleted afterwards.
